system.description: You have incurred the wrath of those higher in station within your clan, who make your unlife miserable — injuring your reputation, spreading nasty gossip, slandering your lovers — for reasons you cannot fully understand. You may find assistance from others who disbelieve the slander, but proving yourself may take considerable effort.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans
